implementation.authorization: Admin explicitly acknowledges one fixed preview text to one existing verified identity/conversation with materialized recent inbound text. Server derives body, event, actor, revision, source fingerprint, callback, expiry. Transaction stores private operation-scoped trial authority and exact durable job; no provider call on prepare
implementation.expiry: Maximum10 minutes, capped by inbound24h window, verification24h freshness and credential expiry. Final boundary rechecks actor/admin membership, source/proof revision, callback, identity/suppression, human_active/AIoff conversation and exact operation/request
implementation.consent: One-operation trial consent only. contacts.opt_in remains false, channel status remains needs_permissions with empty capabilities; no account-wide grants/AI/campaign activation
implementation.isolation: General claim_channel_job excludes trial operations. Explicit send route claims only the named trial and original admin, matching current sourceRevision and server callback; never drains workspace
implementation.transport: Dedicated trial service uses existing sender/adapter and durable begin/outbox/budget/fencing/finish/receipt reconciliation. It does not invent a ready account or persist fake broad policy grants. Trial authority is checked by final SQL boundary
implementation.oneAttempt: No second outbox for trial even after lease recovery. Unknown cannot be resent or replaced by fresh UUID. Provider rejection is terminal even if retryable; only explicit new authorization after definite rejection/cancelled-before-send may create another trial
implementation.revoke: Can retire trial with rollout off. Unsent pending/leased job cancelled; already-permitted in-flight send cannot be retracted. Revocation/replay never reactivates old operation
